notes.title: House Flipper: VR is on Steam VR Fest! Build, insert, remove, and paint!
notes.content:
Hey, hey, fellow VR-Flippers!

We know that many of you probably spend your summer doing some lazy or crazy things, but what would you say about some fresh additions to the House Flipper: VR? Before that, let me thank you for your constant support and feedback! We really appreciate every word you share with us.

It’s been a busy time lately, but the new stuff is here! Without further ado…

Let’s jump to the door inserting mechanic. We’ve added them to your shops and now, you can select your favorite color and open your room to this exciting feature.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/c5e4af10a837ab8822978fabee7f12dbe7a3021d.gif[/img]
[/list]
In the last dev update, we’ve showcased you our special tool for walls. Now it’s time to present some refreshed mechanics! First of all, we’d like you, to look at the building feature.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/6af1734c4580d64506e60ba412049bd53474bef9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/a37598efae05addf5f30269163aa130da84ff4e3.gif[/img]
[/list]
Where the one creates, the second destroys. Now it’s your turn to use the hammer and tear down what you want to remove.
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/7bfc3a4fa01811e38a696dfec3d4d10e653e3ffa.gif[/img]
[/list]
Ahhhh, it’s so satisfying. We can’t stop watching the new filling mechanic. For those of you who wonder about painting mechanic – it looks really similar to the one that you can see below. We're curious what do you think of this feature in that kind of form? Let us know in the comment section below!
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/31a55f3bdc1b7c3e8e61e30ec0aff637fe284517.gif[/img]
[/list]
Next feature is massive! Streamers, prepare your chairs, because you can fall down! We announce, that LIV-system works now, and you can put your avatar in-game. We think it looks so cool. Check it out, and throw your opinion at us.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/0544f7544460fe530f3c622bbdd28a4768387106.gif[/img]

We’ve put a lot of effort into this, and now it’s in your hands. Apart from that, don’t forget to follow our social media for future updates!

Furthermore, we know, that many of you wait for the House Flipper – Pets VR and we have a little news for you, which you can find [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839190/view/3118177241239310834]HERE[/url]! notes.title: House Flipper: VR – Development Update
notes.content:
Hello there, VR Flippers! 

It's Christmas time! Although this is the time when you suppose to rest and spend some time with your family, we are working hard to make your VR experience as pleasant as possible. The recent update has brought some Christmas-themed items and a new house, so you can spend your free time decorating it, and we hope you've loved the changes we've made so far. Curious what we are bringing to you this time? Without further ado, let's get the Christmas rolling!

As you already know, Christmas is all about the snowy environment, when you spend the whole day making a snowman or on snowball fights together with your relatives or your friends. Although you can't do that in House Flipper: VR, we did our best to create the Christmas environment as friendly as possible. Check it out below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/7099bae95c33c8872f76c71766545c2545252a34.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/3835cbe4aa0ab93b6f3f8c7b6fdd367c914ade67.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/a61dc2b73f914d85cbe7297ae9272616ec3d7b11.png[/img]

But that is not the end – we've also managed to put some emphasis on the tablet. Now, it is more pleasant to work on it since it is bigger, but if there is no place to pop it out, the smaller one will spawn, so there is nothing to worry about. We've also improved putting up furniture. Now it is a bit easier to place them in the right place. 

Last but not least, we would like to remind you that now you can grab House Flipper VR with a 50% discount on Steam. So, if you are still looking for a gift, or simply you would like to spend some time decorating houses in virtual reality, do not hesitate, and grab yourself a copy. 

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194700/House_Flipper_VR/][Here is the link to the discount][/url][/h1]

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a happy flipping!

~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: Panel Tool Update
notes.content:
[b]Panel Tool Update is here![/b]

Hey there, VR flippers!

We are happy to announce that the panel tool update is finally out!

Panel Tool will allow you to place panels on the walls of your houses, expanding your options to change the appearance of the rooms, and create something truly unique!
The panels are available in the shop, in their own category - the only thing you need to do is buy them and insert them into the new tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/ba4c8f4ba399ee83683518516a88b42b2366277f.gif[/img]


Once inserted, point at the spot on the wall you’d like to apply the panel to, and press the trigger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/7d6b8999fef1024a8d164aa5c57b942a621f126b.gif[/img]


In order to unlock the new tool, you must pick it up during the Moving in quest. If you have already finished this quest, you will already have access to the Panel Tool.

In addition to the new tool, we’ve added a convenient menu for the tools - it’s a new way of choosing the desired tool quickly and comfortably by pointing at the appropriate icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/afee3889a00e10dcbac8dd13c0cfc92569ea2d4c.gif[/img]


The new additions will give you more possibilities, as well as make your flipping adventures more convenient.

On the final note, make sure to check out our new project that is currently in the development phase called Honeycomb!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/

We hope you’ll enjoy the new features! 

[b]Happy flipping!
~Frozen Way Team[/b]

notes.title: PATCH 1.2 arrives today - Texture and movement tweaks!
notes.content:
Hey there Virtual Flippers!

It's time for another update for House Flipper VR. What's on the menu this time you ask?

Well... first and foremost, influenced by tons of feedback from our community, we made a couple of significant changes in the control system and reworked the tutorial section of the game to give the new players a better understanding of the controls and mechanics.

We also promised to bring you constant content updates, so this time we're adding lots of new colour / material variants. Anyway, without further ado, let's jump into details:



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/886148f7466b13f5106e890f60f0f1082c7564a0.png[/img]

:shard_blue: You can now freely move while holding items - hooray!

:shard_blue: The tutorial has been refreshed and expanded to give you a good grasp of the basic mechanics.

:shard_blue: The trash picker reached its final form and is now even longer - no more back pain!

:shard_blue: Texture upgrade - a new approach to their appearance!

:shard_blue: Colour variants have been improved as well!

:shard_blue: We managed to fix the bug that caused some trash to be invincible.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/57b26e5e7b35c773c9fe080030fe3efb8ca6edfc.png[/img]
[i]"Being able to freely move with items in hand has been one of the most requested features since we released the game, and we felt like it indeed makes a lot of sense. To make it happen, we had to tweak the controls here and there, but finally, we were able to deliver this feature to our players."[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/101b31ab4b6ecd69aa9f165cd3a842201ada63eb.png[/img]
[i]"We also heard that some players are having problems with the trash picker being too short, so we've decided to increase the reach even more (yep, we've already made it longer in the past)."[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/a62d3a70b055f86680f60312e601c44c8a000d5a.png[/img]
[i]"We've also decided to turn up the variety of the items and implemented new material and colour variants. We totally reworked the kitchen furniture when it comes to textures and made some changes which contribute towards a realistic appearance and a consistent style of the items! We hope you'll enjoy them!"[/i]



[i]"Last but not least, we have a little sneak peek for ya! In the next update, we're about to bring you a bunch of new items, focusing on certain styles and themes:"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/99a041335a0464791a8991d3d89be35cde36c2e8.png[/img]

[i]"Stay tuned!"[/i]

notes.title: Controls update - enjoy Vive Cosmos support and many more!
notes.content:
[b]Hey there Virtual Flippers!
It is time for our first post-release update.
This time we gathered all the feedback we had during the first couple of days after the launch, and worked hard to bring you some more support and control adjustments. This is still not everything we're about to improve in the nearest future, but for now, we're happy with the results.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/ffbfec47763d5e5519dd39957ad5986ba394b42b.png[/img]

[b]So here's what the following update brings you:[/b]

[i]- Full Vive COSMOS Support

- Valve Index more intuitive gripping and rotating with the stick

- HTC Vive and Vive Cosmos Elite controls fix

- new item put down physics - items no longer go back to the start position when colliding on put down

- item rotation snap fix

- new 45 snap angle

- Teleporting on carpets available

- Easy and intuitive UI button clicking

- Paintcan not being able to be placed in PaintTool after selling fix[/i]

notes.title: New update + known issues!
notes.content:
[b]Hey there Virtual Flippers![/b]

[b]Yesterday was a big day, not just because of the release and the celebration stream, but also because you gave us lots of initial feedback!
We always say that we're trying to develop our games with the help of our communities, so we cannot thank you enough![/b]



[b]Anyway, let's get to the important stuff!

Here's a couple of answers to the most popular questions / reported issues we've seen on our Community Hub:[/b]

[i]- We're getting ready to introduce full [b]HTC Vive Cosmos support[/b]. It should arrive on [b]Monday - Nov 9[/b].

- If you're having issues with [b]Valve Index[/b], try setting the [b]refresh rate to 80[/b]! (SteamVR->settings->refresh rate)

- We've also added the [b]longer brush[/b] you've seen on stream. No more back pain!

- There were some issues with the [b]classic vive controllers[/b], but they [b]should work much better now[/b]! Try it out and let us know!

- If you're having any issues with smooth locomotion, try switching to [b]"one-handed locomotion"[/b] that has been developed by us specifically for HF:VR. Should work much smoother once you get used to it.

- Sometimes you might experience an issue with [b]no in-game sound[/b]. Try restarting your game (or in the worst case scenario - your PC).[/i]



[b]Next week we're also going to focus on our first post-launch content update that's going to arrive as soon as possible!

Once again, thank you for your honest feedback, and have an amazing weekend! 😃[/b]

notes.title: House Flipper VR release postponed! November 5!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Big news! 🙀[/b][/h3]

[b]After receiving more feedback from our community, we've got a couple of new ideas on how to improve the gameplay of House Flipper VR!

That's why we decided to postpone the release while we're still working on additional functionalities and last polishes.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/d691d10cb90ee72e6ac179d515f21f3ebcd111c4.png[/img]

[i]"We really want to avoid rushing the project and releasing a game that we wouldn't be 100% happy with, that's why we're giving it 2 more weeks!
We feel that having a little bit of extra time will give us more of a comfortable finish in the development process."[/i]



[b]Soon we might throw in a little extra devlog to show you what exactly we're working on during these additional 2 weeks.

Stay tuned and join us during a developer stream on the release day - 5th of November! (more info on that will also come soon!)[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #4! The last pre-release House Flipper VR Devlog!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Flippers!
Another week of development, closer and closer to the release!
Make sure to add House Flipper VR to your wishlist to get reminded when it comes out this month! (October 22nd)[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194700/House_Flipper_VR/


[b]So what we've been up to?

Well, first of all, we've started taking good care of the appraiser system.
At the moment we're working hard to add more of them to the game, and give each one a unique personality and his or her very own taste of style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/4e0dd3831da65cedbeb6fd2ce1f0b6e47e1b47a6.gif[/img]

You can roughly figure out the interior design preferences of the appraisers through their posters.
We also made sure to throw in a bit of realism, as after a successful purchase, the buyer will not be included in the next auction.
Every appraiser also has his personal favorite in terms of properties, and they will buy it without much hesitation, so make sure to figure out their likings!


After all, we've also worked on the graphics a little bit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/98942c664ea3874ee5c5cc4a782588a62c62b5cd.gif[/img]

You can now choose between 6 graphic options: Low, Medium, Normal, High, Very High and Ultra.
Above you can see the comparison between the lowest and the highest setting.


Last but not least there's the environment!
Now you can feel the good vibes in a calm neighborhood... definitely boosts the immersion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/2e788d1028886d905365accf5e22fe6e755c5a2c.png[/img]

That's all for now, October is surely going to be a big month as we're getting very close to the release which is planned on the 22nd.



[i]Stay tuned and thank you for your support![/i][/b]

notes.title: Check out the House Flipper VR Devlog #2!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Flippers!
This is our second official House Flipper VR Devlog in which we decided to show entirely new dirt cleaning mechanics.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/c4750c5a86655683d00da8988c497afb9d521068.png[/img]
 

[b]Given the performance possibilities we've gained by moving the game to the PC platform we were able to change the way our dirt system works.
Before dirts were composed of 3d models that moved with each stroke of a brush.
While cleaning them was fun, we decided that we could provide more variety and even smoother cleaning experience.
New dirts are made out of colorful textures, check out some of them on the following screens:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/86d9e0746b96c7b2a1e91ade8a30a3b0fb702026.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/e7567d2d2fb4b20041de49d33810acaacf0734d2.png[/img]
 

Height of the dirt informs us how much work we'll have to do in order to clean them, we've also added new fx visualising movement of cleaning tool:
All in all, new cleaning experience feels great and makes houses look more diverse, everything provided at a stable framerate![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/d3c1b1115a0f99d0b65cab02d7fd3ab0e21f9406.png[/img]
 

[b][i]Another devlog will be coming up in about 2 weeks from now, be ready and don't forget to add House Flipper VR to your wishlist on Steam![/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194700/House_Flipper_VR/
 
[b][i]Thanks for being here with us![/i][/b]

notes.title: Welcome to House Flipper VR Devlog #1!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey there Flippers!
It's our first official House Flipper VR Devlog, showcasing some of the recent changes and improvements coming to the graphically enhanced Steam VR version of the game.[/b][/h3]


[b]If you didn't have a chance to see the graphically enhanced version, you can find a new video comparing the Steam VR version with the Oculus Quest version on our Steam Store Page:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194700/House_Flipper_VR/


[b]Now let's get to the Devlog!
First of all, we have a new dynamic light system that allows for realistic lighting while still being able to keep the FPS at stable 80!
It is possible thanks to reducing the maximum number of light sources on the scene in a way that does not downgrade the overall lighting quality.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/d8e76a3d89020e2319a9007cf0982e91853a7353.png[/img]


[b]Secondly, there's the carefully picked set of textures visible on the items in the graphically enhanced Steam VR version.
We've tried to go for some lovely stylized looks while keeping ourselves open for adding additional item variants in the future![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/bb041c42aff223ae40f544bd267315ac4c2ff30f.png[/img]


[b]Finally, we have the support for various post-processes, implementation of new visual effects as well as highlight improvements and adding an efficient outline.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/bac0011c996ee9ced5bd30a3ca1da9178f383643.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/2d051eab8a8e4caf86c51bd0e1c142668438be21.png[/img]



[i][b]We have more Devlogs on the way, coming up in about 1 or 2 weeks from now, so make sure to stay tuned!

Thanks for being here with us!
Happy Flipping![/b][/i]
